Anatomy check

His front view measured against a heroic human (Loomis and the Marvel Way, from the Bodies study canon). Lines on him are where his joints sit; green marks are where a heroic man's would be.

9.5 heads tall
A heroic man is 8.5. His small head is a big part of his look.
Head to chest: true
Chin, neck pit, shoulder line and chest line all land within a tenth of a head of the canon.
Shoulders 65% wider
Chest 44% wider and waist 30% wider, but hips normal: a huge wedge on ordinary hips.
Short legs, long arms
Crotch and knees sit half a head low, and his fingertips hang 0.6 of a head below a hero's. That gives him the gorilla stance.
The rule for the model
Joints and muscles follow real anatomy; proportions stay his. The model is scored against him, and the canon only checks that every joint is a real joint.

Measured by hand from the 512-pixel picture, about 3 pixels either way. The camera is slightly low, so his legs may read a little long, not short. The side view from the turnaround will settle depth.

How we build him

The method from the Bruiser Study. If your feedback changes the winner, this follows it.

  1. Turnaround firstFront, side and back of this exact man before any Blender work.
  2. A depth rulerMeshy builds a rough 3D version from the three views. We measure it; we don't ship it.
  3. An anatomy baseAn MPFB human body, muscular and heavy, with a Rigify skeleton in his A pose.
  4. Big flat planesDecimate (planar) turns the body into broad facets, the low-poly look.
  5. Tuned to himPart by part, torso out: small bald head, heavy brow, nose, jaw, giant shoulders, fists, faceted shins.

What every round must pass

Same outline, three sides
Silhouette match from the front, side and back against your pick, from the same camera.
Anatomy check
Head count, limb lengths and joint heights against the Bodies study's human canon.
Simplification
Fewer, bigger planes. No noisy little facets.
Plain briefs
A smooth, plain base layer. Nothing drawn between the legs, ever.
This man, not a cousin
Five fingers on each fist, his face with brow, nose and jaw, his calves and shoes.
